item.title: Watching Entanglement Forget: The Crosscap Quench
item.description: In a crosscap quench, a topologically entangled system forgets its antipodal pairing as entanglement entropy grows linearly, transforming its quantum memory.

item.title: Light Hides a One‑Way Surface Channel
item.description: A single topological twist in the vacuum traps light as a one-way surface wave, even though the material on both sides is empty space.

item.title: A Fireball’s Portrait: How Magnetars Paint with Curved Spacetime
item.description: A computational model decodes how magnetar fireballs imprint curved spacetime and quantum vacuum birefringence onto polarized X-ray bursts, linking stellar mass to light geometry.

item.title: The Radio Glow That Shouldn’t Have Survived: MeerKAT’s Peek into the Early Universe
item.description: MeerKAT's L-band observations reveal luminous radio halos in merging galaxy clusters at redshift >1, challenging models of cosmic microwave background energy losses.
